role: connected multipart preview/decomposition; 3-5 parts with shared stimulus and genuine carry-forward

records.target_text: Connect tables, graphs, equations or rules, and contexts that represent the same relationship.
records.primary_i_can_text: Find matching values across different representations.
supporting_i_can_texts: Create a table or graph from another representation.
Check whether two representations describe the same relationship.
Use values, rate, or pattern as evidence.
records.evidence_job: Connect a context/rule, table, and graph for one relationship and use carried-forward values to reconcile the representations.
records.student_action: Work through a four-part shared-stimulus routine in which each later part uses a representation/result built in an earlier part.
records.difficulty_intent: instructional preview/decomposition; intentionally below secure summative transfer demand
records.structure_fit_notes: A real intermediate result/decision is required and carried into the final result; labeled parts alone are not treated as multi-step.

parts.label: a
parts.student_action: Translate the shared situation/rule into a small value table.

parts.label: b

parts.student_action: Use the graph constructed in part (b) to read a requested value/feature.

parts.label: d
parts.student_action: Use results from the earlier parts to explain how the table and graph show the same relationship.

records.target_text: Read, evaluate, and rewrite expressions without changing their value.

parts.label: a
parts.student_action: Identify the requested term/coefficient/factor structure in the shared expression.

parts.label: b
parts.student_action: Rewrite/simplify the expression using the needed distribution or like-term work.

parts.student_action: Evaluate the original and rewritten forms at the same supplied value.

parts.label: d

records.target_text: Write an equation from a situation and explain what its solution means.

Check and interpret a solution in context.
